title: [AINews] D-Day (Decision Models Day)
author: swyx .ai
description: November 11, 2026 — Google enters the decision model market. At AI Engineer, Cloudflare showed which parts of a build failure a classifier could handle. TypeSafe AI showed off their production customers.
summary: Benchmarks are good ( usual caveat about benchmarks ): And you can hear all this and more on today’s System One track. And support AINews by giving your agent SerpApi to read and crawl the web!
takeaways: Frontier Model Evals: Fable 5.2 Leads, Carbon Draws Speed Complaints Claude Fable 5.2 on Agent Arena : Fable 5.2 (Max) ranks #1 with a +30.4% net improvement across 4.7K real agentic sessions.
AI Twitter Recap Google Launches Gemini Decision 1 for Single-Pass Classification Gemini Decisions API : Google introduced a new API backed by Gemini Decision 1 .
Fast decision models handle tool selection and log extraction, and a large reasoning model handles diagnosis only.
